outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). After approaching the handle, the robot pulls the door outward: frames 130–165 show the door separating from the oven body and tilting open in image and left_ego_image. The door remains visibly ajar at frame 399. The opening is partial rather than fully lowered; no failed acquisition, damage, or unintended object displacement is established.
